concept.title: Kanban board
concept.shortdesc: The Board is a kanban view of the project's work items. Its special trick: cards can be assigned to AI agents, and dragging an agent's card to To Do kicks off an agent run.

conbody.p: Every card is also a task of the project's plan: the Gantt page draws the cards on a timeline, with start dates, sub-tasks and dependencies. See The plan (Gantt).

A card can carry To-dos: open the card, type one under To-dos and press Add, and tick it off when it is done. They are what fills the task's bar on the Gantt, and the To-dos page lists them with the project's others.
